newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts Matrix to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts Matrix to hold.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said Thursday it cut its rating of Matrix Pharmaceutical Inc to hold from buy due to concerns about the AccuSite product for genital warts.

-- UBS said Matrix received its third major setback on Tuesday when the U.S. Food and Drug Administration said AccuSite was "unapprovable" due to inadequate submission information on product chemistry, microbiology and clinical safety issues.
-- UBS said it now expects a nine month delay in the commercialization of AccuSite.
-- UBS said the FDA may require Matrix to submit post-treatment patient saftey data, which would be costly and complicated.
-- UBS said "AccuSite's 'unapprovable' status has heightened concerns over Matrix's inability to execute on a range of previously-stated clinical and commercial objectives."
-- Matrix's stock dropped 1/8 to 6 in morning trading.
